name: Structurally identical events resolve to their own handlers
description: Log and Audit share the shape {string:message} but are distinct nominal events; each emit reaches the handler keyed on its own scope identity, proving identity and not shape decides. Each emit is bound separately because `>-` takes its payload at ASSIGNMENT precedence, so an inline `>- A{..} + >- B{..}` would fold the whole sum into the first payload.
